description: integrations.sh is a registry of developer and agent integration surfaces across many services, including APIs, GraphQL endpoints, MCP servers, and CLIs. It also provides tools for discovering what integration surfaces a domain exposes.
summary: integrations.sh exposes three documented developer surfaces on its own domain: a REST API at `https://integrations.sh/api`, a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://integrations.sh/mcp`, and the `integrations` CLI; the available public docs do not pin down authentication beyond saying no auth is documented.
